currentImplementation: Loopback editor stores SQLite drafts and immutable local review declarations; POST /api/apply always rejects with NO_GAME_SERVER_ADAPTER. No server credentials, client hot reload or live deployment exists.

rules: server validates schema, references, units, bounds and consumer compatibility
reviewer and deployer identities cannot be inferred from typed names
same idempotency key and payload returns same receipt; different payload rejects
ETag mismatch rejects without partial update
future timestamp must carry explicit UTC timezone
rollout targeting must be deterministic per new run

POST /balance/activate.onFailure: keep last known-good active version and produce rejected receipt

POST /balance/rollback.meaning: atomic new activation receipt referencing old immutable payload; never delete history

runningRunPolicy: Each run records and pins its configuration version/hash at creation. Active runs never adopt later edits. New runs use the explicitly activated version/rollout selection.
hotConfigReadiness: NOT_PROVEN. Each key currently has NO_SERVER_ADAPTER; client/code-bound values require separately verified consumers and release compatibility.
publicSecurity: GitHub Pages contains read-only data and no editor or write service. Local editor binds 127.0.0.1, validates Host/Origin and CSRF, and does not claim authenticated multi-user roles.
rollbackDistinction: The local restore button copies immutable values into a revision-guarded draft. It is not live server rollback.
